reason: The current GO atomic-lease protocol permits timestamp fallback only when the immutable source user-message timestamp has at least whole-second precision. Appending 00 seconds to minute-only metadata does not create admissible trigger identity. The claim is preserved for audit but cannot authorize execution.
required_action: Do not execute this or any other unusual experiment for the 13:42 user-triggered go unless a shared immutable request/turn identifier or admissible whole-second-or-better immutable source timestamp is actually exposed. Ordinary deterministic regressions/source review may continue.
